name: acom-flex-bridge
description: Station dashboard and translator bridging an ACOM S-series amp + 04AT/06AT autotuner to a FlexRadio via the native SmartSDR TCP API. Works alongside SmartSDR, AetherSDR, or Maestro - on Windows, macOS, Linux, or a Raspberry Pi.

scripts.check: node -e "const {execFileSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const files=['bridge.js','diag.js',...fs.readdirSync('lib').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).map(f=>'lib/'+f)];for(const f of files)execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('syntax ok ('+files.length+' files)')"
scripts.ports: node -e "require('serialport').SerialPort.list().then(p => console.table(p.map(x => ({path: x.path, manufacturer: x.manufacturer, serial: x.serialNumber}))))"
